## Overview

This directory contains application-level governance patterns for verifying architectural properties at runtime and ensuring AI agents generate catalog-conforming output from the start. These patterns implement Layers 2 and 4 of the four-layer verification architecture, and establish the AI agent context integration that reduces conformance failures at generation time.

Together, these patterns address the two dimensions of the post-build governance gap: what the running service actually does (behavioral verification) and what instructions guide AI agents before they generate anything (context integration).

[patterns/application/governance/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

Establish application-level governance that:

- Verifies architectural properties requiring code execution at pipeline time — PHI handling, observability wiring, resilience configuration (L2)
- Embeds Golden Path catalog references and compliance constraints into repositories so AI agents default to catalog-conforming output
- Continuously monitors production behavioral invariants and infrastructure drift, closing the post-deployment compliance gap (L4)

## Implementation Phasing

These patterns align to the phases defined in the [Enterprise Golden Path Strategy](../../../strategy/white-papers/engineering/enterprise-golden-path-strategy.md):

| Phase | Patterns Required | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| Phase 2 — Governance Automation | PTN-APP-GOV-001, PTN-APP-GOV-002 | Months 7–12 |
| Phase 3 — Autonomous Development | PTN-APP-GOV-003 | Months 13–24 |

[patterns/application/governance/README.md#four-layer-verification-architecture]

## Four-Layer Verification Architecture

These patterns implement 2 of the 4 verification layers, plus a preventive context control:

```
L1: Architecture Conformance Gate ◄── PTN-INFRA-GOV-001 (infrastructure/governance)
        ↓
L2: Architecture Fitness Functions ◄── PTN-APP-GOV-001 (this directory)
        ↓
L3: Policy-as-Code Enforcement ◄── PTN-INFRA-GOV-002 (infrastructure/governance)
        ↓
L4: Runtime Behavioral Monitors ◄── PTN-APP-GOV-003 (this directory)

Preventive: AI Agent Context Integration ◄── PTN-APP-GOV-002 (this directory)
            (reduces L1–L3 failure rate at generation time)
```
